brief:
Shehab Wire reported that the "Dawn Men" initiative encourages children and youth to pray the dawn prayer in congregation, expanding from Algeria across Jordan, Morocco, Egypt, Turkey, India, and other nations. The program, organized largely through mosques, has gained traction as a grassroots movement to build religious habit among younger generations.

The initiative reflects efforts by Islamic communities to involve children in daily worship practices and foster collective spiritual observance from an early age.

title: Dawn Men initiative spreads children's dawn prayer across Muslim countries
